item.title: ROP (Return-Oriented Programming)
item.description: Return-Oriented Programming chains short existing code gadgets ending in ret to compute arbitrary logic and bypass DEP/NX.

item.title: Stack Overflows
item.description: Stack overflow exploitation methodology - crash analysis, offset determination, ret2libc, and a complete end-to-end walkthrough on x86-64 Linux.

item.title: Stack
item.description: The call stack - frame structure, prologue/epilogue, System V AMD64 ABI, stack canaries, alignment, GDB inspection, and stack overflow.

item.title: System Calls
item.description: The gateway between user space and kernel space - syscall mechanism, Linux syscall table, strace deep dive, raw syscall invocation, vDSO.

item.title: TCP Fingerprinting
item.description: Passive and active OS detection through TCP/IP stack analysis - TTL, window size, option ordering, ISN generation, and cross-protocol fingerprinting techniques.

item.title: TCP
item.description: The Transmission Control Protocol and its three-way handshake and connection state machine.

item.title: Threads
item.description: POSIX threads, synchronization primitives, race conditions, deadlocks, thread-local storage, and the NPTL implementation on Linux.

item.title: TLS
item.description: Transport Layer Security from first principles - TLS 1.3 handshake mechanics, cipher suites, ECDHE key exchange, X.509 certificate structure, SNI, ALPN, mutual TLS, certificate pinning, and inspecting TLS with openssl and Python.

item.title: TOCTOU
item.description: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use filesystem races - symlink swaps, access/open gaps, O_NOFOLLOW, openat, mkstemp, hardlink attacks, /proc/self/fd tricks, and atomic file operations.

item.title: UDP Scanning
item.description: UDP port scanning mechanics - why it is slow, ICMP rate limiting, service-specific probes, nmap -sU internals, writing a raw UDP scanner in Python, and unicornscan as a high-speed alternative.

item.title: UDP
item.description: UDP port scanning mechanics, ICMP rate limiting, and service-specific probes.

item.title: HTTP
item.description: Hypertext Transfer Protocol/1.1 from first principles - request/response structure, headers deep dive, status codes, methods and idempotency, cookies, CORS, URL encoding, persistent connections, chunked transfer, and writing a minimal HTTP server in Python.

item.title: Use After Free
item.description: Dangling pointers, heap reuse, object layout overlap, and vtable hijack via UAF - why freeing memory does not null the pointer and how reused chunks become type-confused.

item.title: Virtual Memory
item.description: Page tables, TLB, page faults, mmap() internals, malloc() backend, /proc/PID/maps dissection, huge pages, ASLR, overcommit, and the OOM killer.

item.title: Cookie Tzu - The Art of Cyber
item.description: A strategic treatise adapting the thirteen chapters of Sun Tzu's Art of War to the domain of cyber warfare.

item.title: Strategies
item.description: This learning path teaches the strategic dimension of cyber warfare.
